title: Boots and Bullets - 24 hour prototype, 10 days polish & release
author: DarrenMoore
selftext:
My second AI written game - [Boots and Bullets](https://bootsandbullets.com), a remake of Cannon Fodder.

Mostly Claude Opus 5, a bit of Fable and some Astro for an experiment with some new map objects (because it has image creation abilities). Suno for the music.

* 24 hours build a prototype, released and showed a few friends, they showed interest
* 10 more days for polish, more maps, clean up rough edges, make it look cool - released and got 600+ visitors
* and then another 10+ days with a bit more polish and here we are now

Doing this while my normal work stuff so it's not all back to back.

Also this video is totally scripted. I got AI to build up simulations so it can playtest and record every map. And it can make videos with some code independent from the game, it'll write the script, prepare the screens, simulate the maps and stitch it together. To make this video in 1 minute my prompt was:

>/media new video...  
youtube width  
  
words we want are..  
\- hey reddit  
\- something about this game  
\- let me know what you think  
\- we have weapons <show weapons>  
\- we have fighting and explosions  
\- we even have chickens and zombies  
\- then say 3 zones  
\- and then say how many maps we have  
\- all for free on desktop only  
\- sorry no mobile yet

I wrote up a [devlog article](https://inselnova.com/chronicle/2026-09-08-boots-and-bullets/) and welcoming any questions or feedback on the game.

[https://bootsandbullets.com](https://bootsandbullets.com)
